title: SMA Test Portal — CBT Exam Engine
description: High-throughput computer-based test platform replicating NTA examination interfaces for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and NEET. Engineered for zero-latency question navigation, real-time timer tracking, state synchronization, and dynamic KaTeX mathematical formula evaluation.

title: Physics Worksheet Vault (DPP Archive)
description: Digital repository of Daily Practice Problems (DPP) and categorized physics worksheets for competitive students. Includes problem classifications across Mechanics, Electrodynamics, and Optics with analytical solutions, vector diagrams, and downloadable modules.

title: Anokhi Ada — Fashion & Accessories
description: Modern commercial e-commerce storefront for hair accessories, jewelry, and craft supplies in India. Implements mobile-first catalog browsing, cart operations, dynamic inventory tracking, customer review workflows, and streamlined checkout architecture.

title: Interactive Mechanics Vector Visualizer
description: Zero-dependency client-side HTML5 canvas physics simulator executing real-time numerical integration (Euler/Verlet) for non-linear pendulum oscillations, damping, and phase-space vector telemetry. Runs at a rock-solid 60 FPS directly in your browser.

title: Procedural Problem & PDF Generator
description: Algorithmic problem synthesis engine that parameterizes physics problem geometry and kinematics symbolically, synthesizing randomized DPP problem sheets, vector diagrams, and publication-ready PDFs with step-by-step KaTeX solutions.
